messages.content: New one: beverage bottling plant in the Inland Empire. Target week is Mon Mar 9. Tuesday afternoon instrumentation review, then Wednesday 6:00 a.m. sanitation and CIP observation. They may add a Thursday engineering closeout. Can you build a flight, rental, and hotel shortlist?

Yes. Which plant area, and are Ontario and Burbank both acceptable? Also, should I assume you want enough Monday evening time for rental pickup, check-in, and prep rather than just the latest arrival?

Plant is around the Fontana/Rialto line off I-10. Ontario or Burbank are acceptable, but protect the Wednesday morning. SFO is easiest for me, OAK is okay, SJC last. Clean routing matters more than carrier. Monday afternoon departure is fine, but I don't want to land after 6:30 if I can avoid it.

Ontario is the cleaner airport for this. Burbank works only as a backup because the Monday afternoon drive across can run 70-100 minutes. Flight shortlist: United SFO-ONT about 1:40-3:05 nonstop; Southwest OAK-ONT about 2:25-3:45 nonstop; United or Southwest into BUR around 3:15-4:35, but with the longer drive. I would avoid one-stop routings through Phoenix or LAX unless price forces it.
Keep Burbank as backup only. I need a rental car either way, probably compact. Give me two hotel zones.

For ONT, a compact rental pickup around 3:30-4:00 p.m. gives you enough evening margin. Hotel zones: Ontario airport/Ontario Mills is easiest on arrival and return, usually 20-30 minutes to the plant early morning. Rancho Cucamonga is a good middle ground with better dinner choices and a 15-25 minute pre-dawn drive. Fontana is closest, often 10-15 minutes, but the hotel pool is thinner.
Specific hotels, please. Decent guest ratings, parking, and a fridge if we can get it. I'll have sample bottles.

Shortlist: Ayres Hotel Ontario Mills, roughly 4.5 guest rating, free parking, breakfast, coffee maker and fridge, lots of dinner nearby. Hyatt Place Ontario/Rancho Cucamonga, roughly 4.2, free parking, fridge and coffee maker, very easy restaurant access. Hilton Garden Inn Ontario/Rancho Cucamonga, roughly 4.3, parking, on-site restaurant/bar. Hilton Garden Inn Fontana, roughly 4.1, closest drive, but I would verify the in-room fridge.
Which is best fit if Wednesday starts at 6?

If the only goal is minimum drive, Hilton Garden Inn Fontana wins. But the better overall fit is Hyatt Place Ontario/Rancho: easier Monday arrival, better dinner options, solid guest feedback, and still only about 15-20 minutes to the Fontana/Rialto area if you leave around 5:15 a.m.
I don't need closest at all costs. I do need a low-friction Monday night and somewhere I can get dinner without a production.

Then I would put Hyatt Place Ontario/Rancho first. Acceptable backup is Ayres Ontario Mills if the rate is better or you want the easiest ONT airport return. Fontana only becomes the pick if the plant moves the Wednesday check-in earlier or gives you a gate closer to that side.
How does the spare sensor kit affect this? It may not reach them until Tuesday morning.

The flight timing does not solve that by itself. The Monday SFO-ONT nonstop is still useful because you land early enough to buy small consumables, check the data package, and coordinate with the plant. For the kit, best path is ship direct to the plant receiving dock by Monday or to the hotel with your name and arrival date as backup. If it is Tuesday delivery, ask the plant to confirm who signs before the 2:00 p.m. instrumentation review.
Return flight options? Wednesday could wrap around 2, but they might add Thursday 9 to 11 for engineering.

Two booking approaches: book outbound now and hold the return until they confirm the closeout, or book a changeable Thursday afternoon return and move it earlier if Wednesday clears. From ONT, a Wednesday 7-ish p.m. return is safer than a 5:20 p.m. if you have a 2:00 plant wrap plus rental return. If Thursday is added, aim for an early-afternoon nonstop after the 9-11 closeout.
I don't love paying for an extra hotel night if they don't need me Thursday.

Use a cancellable hotel reservation that can be shortened. Book Mar 9-11 as the base, then either add Mar 11-12 once the closeout is real or book all three nights only if the hotel confirms you can drop the last night by Tuesday evening without penalty.
Can you give me the shortlist in my terms: best fit, acceptable backup, and ask-before-booking items?

Best fit: Mon Mar 9 SFO-ONT nonstop around 1:40-3:05, compact rental at ONT, Hyatt Place Ontario/Rancho for Mar 9-11 with a cancellable path for Mar 11-12, and a Wednesday 7-ish p.m. ONT return if no closeout. Working flow: land, car by 3:45-4:00, hotel and dinner by early evening, Tuesday 2:00 instrumentation review, Wednesday leave hotel about 5:15 for the 6:00 CIP observation. Acceptable backup: OAK-ONT nonstop around 2:25-3:45 if SFO pricing is poor; Ayres Ontario Mills if Hyatt rate jumps; Burbank only if ONT options break. Ask before booking: final gate/address, whether Thursday 9-11 closeout is real, hotel last-night cancellation rule, and where the spare sensor kit should be shipped.
